23
Translation Howto
The full source of the book is available from the Git repository https://github.
com/swaroopch/byte_of_python.
Please fork the repository.
Then, fetch the repository to your computer. You need to know how to use Git
to do that.
Start editing the .pd ﬁles to your local language.
Please read the Pandoc
README to understand the formatting of the text.
Then follow the instructions in the README to install the software required to
be able to convert the raw source ﬁles into PDFs, etc.
